call_points.text: Management committed to maintaining Q1FY27 growth momentum in Q2FY27
New verticals investment reduced 8% YoY to ₹37 Cr, focus on scalable opportunities
Ted Baker losses expected to be $2-3 million for FY27, resolution with ABG ongoing
Management expects mid-single-digit revenue growth and around 10% profit growth for FY27.
Gross margin is targeted to improve by 40-50 bps annually over the next 1-2 years.
No numeric FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management only says it enters FY27 leaner with a clearer line of sight to margin improvement.
Order book strengthened to ~₹5,074 Cr, up 11%, as of early April 2026.
A ~$50 mn Sourcing-as-a-Service mandate was signed in February 2026 with a leading US value retailer.
Effective tax rate rose to 14% in FY26 from 10% in FY25, mainly due to Pillar II impact.
Operating cash flow was ₹781 Cr versus an outflow of ₹37 Cr in FY25.
Capex was 56% lower than the FY25 level.
New Lobster was hit by geopolitical tensions and the US-Iran conflict, deferring select Middle East orders.
Techno Design was hit by Gerry Weber entering administration, though H2 swung to a ~$1.5 Mn profit from a ~$0.7 Mn H1 loss.

operating_notes.text: PDS's step-down subsidiary Poeticgem International Limited is incorporated in Hong Kong with a liaison office in Bangladesh.
Auditor Walker Chandiok & Co LLP did not audit 110 subsidiaries, which contributed ₹1,062,745.45 lakh revenue and ₹25,641.73 lakh net profit in FY26.
Working capital cycle reduced to 4 days in FY26 from 17 days in FY25.
Top 10 sourcing verticals, about 71% of topline, saw revenue fall ~4% and PBT fall ~21% in FY26.
New vertical EBITDA losses were ₹124.2 Cr in FY26 versus ₹162.5 Cr in FY25.
QIP of ₹430 Cr gross (₹410.56 Cr net) raised 22-27 August 2024; ₹302.56 Cr utilised by Mar-2026, ₹108.00 Cr unutilised.
Of the ₹27,950 lakh debt-repayment object, ₹27,836 lakh was used; of the ₹13,105.96 lakh acquisitions/GCP object, only ₹2,420.13 lakh was used.
FY26 GMV was ₹19,666 Cr, up 5% YoY, against revenue from operations of ₹13,110 Cr.
FY26 gross margin improved 48 bps to 20.6% while EBITDA margin fell to 2.94% from 3.63%.
Net working capital improved to about 4 days in FY26 from about 17 days, with ₹781 Cr operating cash flow.
FY26 net working capital days reduced to about 4 days.
Q1FY27 GMV was ₹5,146 Cr, up 11% YoY
Net working capital improved to 1 day in Q1FY27 from 4 days at March 2026
New sourcing as a service contracts have annual potential of US$330 million
Acquired remaining 49% stake in DBS Lifestyle HK for USD 4,900, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.

timeline.summary: On 20 April 2026, PDS disclosed suspected professional misconduct by a former senior employee of step-down subsidiary Poeticgem International, with transactions of about ₹20.15 Cr under review and an FIR registered on 18 April 2026.
Pallak Seth and Pulkit Seth, Promoters, declared no new encumbrances on PDS Limited shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

On 15 May 2026, PDS reported audited FY26 results with an unmodified audit opinion, recommended a ₹1.65 final dividend, set its 15th AGM for 31 July 2026 and approved second-term re-appointments of two independent directors.
On 15 May 2026, PDS Limited released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, reporting ₹19,666 Cr in GMV and a sharp reduction in net debt to ₹105 Cr.
On 18 May 2026, PDS Limited reported FY26 revenue of ₹13,110 Cr with net debt declining to ₹105 Cr and operating cash flow at ₹781 Cr.
PDS Limited announced its recognition as a Great Place to Work across 10 countries.
PDS Limited held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 10, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹3,444 Cr (+15% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹96 Cr (+90% YoY)
PDS Sourcing acquired the remaining 49% stake in DBS Lifestyle HK on October 20, 2026, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
